243: And not only that. Rather, with everything that the Holy One, blessed be He, made during the acts of creation — he stipulated a condition with all of them. On the first day, He created the heavens; He stipulated a condition with them that they bring up Elijah in the midst of a whirlwind. And so it was, as it is written: and Elijah went up to the heavens in a whirlwind (II Kings 2:11). On that day, He [also] created light; He stipulated a condition with it that it should darken the Sun in Egypt for three days, as it is written: and there was thick darkness upon all the land of Egypt for three days (Exodus 10:22).
